paragraphs.en: On Monday evening before the picnic, Marilla approached Anne in her room, looking troubled.
paragraphs.zh: 星期一傍晚野餐前，玛丽拉在安妮的房间里找到她，看上去有些忧虑。

paragraphs.en: "Anne," she said, "did you see my amethyst brooch? I thought I placed it in my pincushion after church yesterday, but now I can't find it."
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，”玛丽拉说，“你看到我的紫水晶胸针了吗？我以为昨天去教堂后把它放在了针线盒里，但现在怎么也找不到了。”

paragraphs.en: "I saw it this afternoon when you were at the Aid Society," Anne replied hesitantly. "I noticed it on your cushion and went inside to take a closer look."
paragraphs.zh: “今天下午你在救济协会的时候，我看见它了，”安妮犹豫着回答，“我注意到你坐垫上有这个东西，便进去仔细看了看。”

paragraphs.en: "Did you touch it?" Marilla asked sternly.
paragraphs.zh: “你碰过它吗？”玛丽拉严肃地问道。

paragraphs.en: "Yes, I picked it up and pinned it on my dress to see how it looked," admitted Anne.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，我捡起来别在裙子上看了看效果如何。”安妮承认道。

paragraphs.en: "You shouldn't have done that. It's wrong for a girl to meddle with things not her own. You had no business going into my room or touching the brooch."
paragraphs.zh: 你这样做不对。女孩子不该干预不属于自己的事情。你根本没有理由擅自进入我的房间，更不应该动那枚胸针。

paragraphs.en: Marilla searched the bureau thoroughly but found nothing. "The brooch isn't here. Where did you put it?"
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉仔细搜查了梳妆台，但一无所获。“胸针不见了。你把它放哪儿了？”

paragraphs.en: "I returned it," Anne said quickly, though Marilla thought she sounded defensive. "I can’t remember exactly where I placed it—on the pincushion or in the china tray—but I’m sure I put it back."
paragraphs.zh: “我归还了它，”安妮迅速说道，尽管玛丽拉觉得她听起来有些 defensively。“我不记得确切放在哪里了——可能是针垫上或是瓷盘里吧，但我肯定放回去了。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla decided to search again. "If you put it back, it should be here. If not, you didn't," she said firmly.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉决定再找一次。“如果你放回原处，应该在这里。如果不在这里，那就说明你没放。”她坚定地说。

paragraphs.en: She went to her room and searched meticulously, checking every possible spot. Finding nothing, Marilla returned to the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 她回到自己的房间，仔细搜寻每一个可能的地方。找不到任何线索后，玛丽拉回到了厨房。

paragraphs.en: "Anne, the brooch is gone. You were the last to handle it. Tell me the truth—did you take it out and lose it?"
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，胸针不见了。你最后才碰过它。说实话吧——是你拿出去弄丢的吗？”

paragraphs.en: Anne stood firm, meeting Marilla's angry gaze directly. "No, I didn't," she said solemnly. "I never took the brooch from your room."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮坚定地站立着，直视着玛丽拉愤怒的目光。“不，我没有。”她庄重地说，“我从未从你的房间里拿走那枚胸针。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla saw defiance in Anne’s “so there.” She retorted sharply, "I believe you are lying to me, Anne."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉从安妮的“那又怎么样”中看到了反抗。她尖锐地反驳道：“我相信你在骗我，安妮。”

paragraphs.en: "Go to your room and stay there until you are ready to confess," Marilla ordered.
paragraphs.zh: “去你的房间待着，直到你准备好承认错误为止。”玛丽拉命令道。

paragraphs.en: Anne meekly asked, "Will I take the peas with me?"
paragraphs.zh: 安妮温顺地问道：“这些豌豆我一起带回去吗？”

paragraphs.en: "No, finish shelling them yourself. Do as I bid you."
paragraphs.zh: “不，你自己把壳剥了。照我说的做。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla was disturbed by her evening tasks. She worried about the missing brooch and Anne's denial. "Of course, she didn't mean to steal it," Marilla thought nervously while shelling peas.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉对晚上的任务感到不安。她担心那枚失踪的胸针，还有安妮的否认。“当然，她无意中拿走它了。”玛丽拉紧张地一边剥豌豆一边暗自思量。

paragraphs.en: "She must have taken it for play or her imagination. But there hasn’t been anyone else in that room since she was in it."
paragraphs.zh: 她一定是把它当作游戏或只是自己的想象吧。不过，自从她进去之后，房间里就没有其他人了。

paragraphs.en: Marilla searched for the brooch throughout the evening but found nothing. She visited Anne's room at bedtime, still no luck.
paragraphs.zh: 玛莉拉整个晚上都在寻找那枚胸针，但一无所获。她在安妮睡前去她的房间看了看，依然没有找到。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, Marilla told Matthew about the incident. He was surprised and puzzled but reluctantly admitted that circumstances suggested Anne might be guilty.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天早上，玛丽拉把这件事告诉了马修。他感到惊讶又困惑，但还是勉强承认情况表明安妮可能有嫌疑。

paragraphs.en: Marilla searched thoroughly but found no brooch behind the bureau or in any crack. "That child has taken it and lied about it," she declared grimly to Matthew.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉仔细搜查了一番，但并未在写字台后面或任何缝隙中找到那枚胸针。“那个孩子拿走了，并且撒了谎。”她对马修严肃地说。

paragraphs.en: Matthew felt relieved that Marilla was handling the situation, offering little help. "What are you going to do?" he asked forlornly.
paragraphs.zh: 马修松了口气，见玛丽拉在处理这件事，自己只需在一旁提供很少的帮助。“你要怎么办呢？”他垂头丧气地问道。

paragraphs.en: Marilla decided Anne would stay in her room until she confessed. If she did, they might find the brooch; otherwise, severe punishment awaited.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉决定让安妮待在房间里，直到她主动承认错误。如果安妮肯认错，或许能找到那枚胸针；否则，等待她的将是严厉的惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Anne refused to confess, insisting she hadn't taken it. Marilla felt pity but kept it hidden. By night, she was exhausted and firm: "You'll stay here until you confess."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮坚决不肯承认，坚持说自己没有拿走那东西。玛丽拉感到有些怜悯，但强忍着没表现出来。到了晚上，她疲惫而坚定地说道：“你必须待在这里，直到你肯承认为止。”

paragraphs.en: "But tomorrow is the picnic," Anne cried. "Please let me go for just the afternoon. I’ll stay after if that helps.
paragraphs.zh: “但是明天就是野餐了，”安妮喊道，“求求你让我下午去吧。如果那样能帮上忙，我会留下来帮忙的。”

paragraphs.en: But I must go to the picnic."
paragraphs.zh: 但我必须去野餐。

paragraphs.en: Marilla shut the door firmly, leaving Anne alone with her dilemma.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉紧紧关上了门，留下安妮独自面对她的困境。

paragraphs.en: On Wednesday morning, Anne sat resolutely on her bed, pale and determined, with tight lips and gleaming eyes. She began, “Marilla, I’m ready to confess.”
paragraphs.zh: 星期三早晨，安妮坚定地坐在床上，脸色苍白但下定决心，紧闭着嘴唇，眼中闪烁着光芒。她开口说道：“玛丽拉，我准备好了，要向你坦白。”

paragraphs.en: “Let me hear what you have to say,” Marilla replied.
paragraphs.zh: “把你想说的都告诉我吧，”玛丽拉回答道。

paragraphs.en: Anne recounted, “I took the amethyst brooch as you said. It looked so beautiful when I pinned it on my breast that I was tempted. I imagined playing Lady Cordelia Fitzgerald with a real amethyst brooch.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮回忆道：“我按照你说的拿走了紫水晶胸针。当我把它别在胸口时，它看起来如此美丽，让我心动不已。我想象自己像科黛丽亚·菲茨杰拉德小姐一样，佩戴着真正的紫水晶胸针。”

paragraphs.en: Roseberries can’t compare to amethysts. So I took it. I thought I could put it back before you came home, but it slipped through my fingers and sank into the Lake of Shining Waters.”
paragraphs.zh: 紫罗兰浆果远不及紫水晶珍贵。所以我拿了它。原本打算你回家前再放回去，但它从我指缝中溜走，沉入了银湖之中。

paragraphs.en: Marilla felt anger rise. “Anne, this is terrible,” she said calmly. “You are the wickedest girl I’ve ever heard of.”
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉感到怒火中烧。“安妮，这太糟糕了，”她冷静地说，“你是我听过的最恶毒的姑娘。”

paragraphs.en: Anne sighed resignedly. "Yes, I suppose I am," she said calmly. "And I know I'll have to be punished.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮叹了口气，显得无可奈何。“是的，我想我是这样。”她平静地说，“我知道我会受到惩罚的。

paragraphs.en: Marilla, it will be your duty to punish me."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉，惩罚我的责任就交给你了。

paragraphs.en: "Picnic? Not today!" Marilla declared sternly.
paragraphs.zh: “野餐？今天没门！”玛丽拉坚定地说道。

paragraphs.en: "That's your punishment, and it’s not enough for what you've done!"
paragraphs.zh: “这就让你受点教训，可对你所做的还远远不够！”

paragraphs.en: Anne leapt up, clutching Marilla's hand. "But you promised I could go! Please let me attend the picnic.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮猛地站起身，抓住玛丽拉的手。“可是你答应我可以去的！求求你让我参加野餐吧。”

paragraphs.en: Think of the ice cream—maybe it will be my last chance."
paragraphs.zh: 想想那冰淇淋吧—— maybe 它可能是我最后一次机会。

paragraphs.en: Marilla pulled away, hard. "No pleading now. You're not going to the picnic, and that’s final."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉坚定地抽回了手。“现在别再求了。你不去野餐，这是最终决定。”

paragraphs.en: Anne collapsed on the bed, sobbing loudly. "For the land's sake!" Marilla rushed out, muttering about a crazy child.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮瘫坐在床上，抽泣声很大。“天哪！”玛丽拉急忙跑过来，嘴里嘟囔着一个疯丫头。

paragraphs.en: That morning was grim for Marilla. She worked tirelessly, scrubbing the porch floor and dairy shelves until she found nothing else to do. Then she raked the yard.
paragraphs.zh: 那个早晨对玛丽拉来说格外阴郁。她不停地忙碌着，擦洗前廊和奶房的架子，直到再也找不到其他可以做的活儿。随后，她开始打扫院子。

paragraphs.en: At dinner time, Marilla called Anne down. A tear-stained face appeared over the banisters. "Come down to your dinner," Marilla said softly.
paragraphs.zh: 晚餐时间到了，玛丽拉叫安妮下来。只见一张泪痕未干的脸出现在楼梯栏杆后面。“下来吃饭吧。”玛丽拉轻声说道。

paragraphs.en: Anne sobbed, "I don't want any dinner. My heart is broken. You'll feel remorse someday for breaking it, but I forgive you.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮抽泣着说：“我不想要晚饭了。我的心碎了。总有一天你会为打破它而后悔，但我还是原谅你了。”

paragraphs.en: Please don’t force me to eat boiled pork and greens—they are so unromantic when one is in affliction."
paragraphs.zh: 请别逼我吃煮猪肉和青菜——在这种不幸的时候，它们未免太平淡无奇了。

paragraphs.en: Marilla returned to the kitchen, exasperated, and told Matthew about her troubles.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉气得回到了厨房，向马修倾诉了自己的烦恼。

paragraphs.en: Matthew admitted his mistake, lamenting Anne's actions but defending her as a child. "She shouldn't have taken the brooch or lied about it," he said, looking at his unromantic meal. "But she’s such an interesting little thing."
paragraphs.zh: 马修承认了自己的错误，对安妮的行为表示遗憾，但还是为她这个孩子辩护道：“她不该拿那枚胸针还撒谎。”他一边说，一边看着面前这顿不浪漫的饭菜。“但她是个如此有趣的小家伙。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla was frustrated with Matthew’s leniency and Anne’s lack of remorse. “I’m amazed at you,” Marilla said. “You’re making excuses for her.”
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉对马修的宽容和安妮缺乏悔意感到失望，“我真不敢相信你。”玛丽拉说道，“你为她开脱理由。”

paragraphs.en: Matthew weakly repeated, “She’s a little thing.” He acknowledged that allowances should be made, noting Anne had no proper upbringing.
paragraphs.zh: 马修有气无力地重复道：“她是个小个子。”他承认应该给予一些宽容，毕竟安妮没有接受过正规的教育。

paragraphs.en: Marilla decided to mend the rent in her shawl. In doing so, sunlight revealed an amethyst brooch caught in the lace. She gasped, realizing it was her missing brooch from Barry's pond.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉决定修补自己围巾上的破洞。阳光透过围巾的蕾丝时，她发现一枚紫水晶胸针卡在了里面。她不禁倒抽了一口气，意识到这正是她在巴里的池塘边丢失的那个胸针。

paragraphs.en: "Dear life and heart," Marilla said blankly. "What does this mean?" She went to Green Gables’ east gable with the brooch.
paragraphs.zh: “亲爱的生与心啊，”玛丽拉机械地说，“这什么意思？”她拿着胸针走向绿山墙东面的墙角。

paragraphs.en: Anne had cried and sat dejectedly by the window.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮哭完后，坐在窗前闷闷不乐。

paragraphs.en: Marilla confronted Anne solemnly: “Anne Shirley, I found my brooch on your shawl. What did you mean by that story?”
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉庄重地对安妮说道：“安妮·夏利，我发现我的胸针在你的围巾上。你那样说是什么意思？”

paragraphs.en: Anne sighed wearily and replied, "You said you'd keep me here until I confessed, so I decided to confess because I had to get to the picnic anyway. Last night, after bed, I planned a confession and repeated it many times."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮疲惫地叹了口气，回答说：“你曾说过要留我在此直到我坦白为止，所以我决定现在就坦白，因为我无论如何都要去野餐的。昨晚睡前，我就计划好了要说的话，并反反复复地说了很多遍。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla chuckled despite her reservations. "Anne, you really outdo yourself! But I was wrong—I see that now.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉虽然有些犹豫，还是忍不住笑了起来。“安妮，你真是越来越出乎我的意料了！但我错了——我现在看得出来了。

paragraphs.en: I shouldn't have doubted your word when I'd never known you to lie. It wasn’t right for you to confess something you hadn’t done, but I drove you there. So if you forgive me, Anne, I’ll forgive you and we can start fresh."
paragraphs.zh: 我不该对你的话产生怀疑，毕竟你从不撒谎。你没有必要为一件自己没有做过的事情承认错误，但正是我逼你说出了真相。所以安妮，如果你能原谅我，我也愿意原谅你，让我们重新开始吧。

paragraphs.en: Anne leaped up like a rocket. "Marilla, isn't it too late?"
paragraphs.zh: 安妮像火箭一样跳了起来。“玛丽拉，现在不是太晚了吧？”

paragraphs.en: "No, only two o'clock. They won't gather until later, and they'll have tea in an hour. Wash your face, comb your hair, and put on the gingham dress.
paragraphs.zh: “不，才两点钟。她们不会这么早过来，一个小时后她们会先喝杯茶再开始准备。快洗洗脸，梳梳头，换上那件条纹布裙子吧。”

paragraphs.en: I’ll fill a basket for you with baked goods. And I’ll get Jerry to hitch up the sorrel and drive you down."
paragraphs.zh: 我会给你装一篮子烘培食品。还有，我会让杰里套上红棕色马车，送你一程。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, Marilla," Anne exclaimed, rushing to the washstand. "Just five minutes ago, I was so miserable I wished I'd never been born, but now I wouldn’t trade places with an angel!"
paragraphs.zh: “哦，玛丽拉，”安妮脱口而出，冲到梳妆台前。“刚才我还那么难过，恨不得自己从未出生过，但现在我宁愿和天使交换位置！”

paragraphs.en: That night, Anne returned to Green Gables thoroughly happy yet completely exhausted from her blissful day. "Oh, Marilla, it was a perfectly scrumptious time. Scrumptious is a new word I learned today.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，安妮回到绿山墙农舍，心情无比愉快却又疲惫不堪。她兴奋地说：“哦，玛丽拉，今天真是美妙极了。‘美味’这个词是我今天刚学会的。”

paragraphs.en: Everything was lovely—splendid tea and a row on the Lake of Shining Waters with Mr. Harmon Andrews. Jane nearly fell in; if he hadn’t caught her, she might have drowned. I wish it had been me—it would be such a romantic experience."
paragraphs.zh: 一切都很美好——茶也极好，与哈蒙·安德鲁斯先生在闪耀湖上划船时更是如此。简差点儿掉进水里；要不是他及时拉住了她，她可能真的会被淹死。我希望那能是我经历一次如此浪漫的事情。

paragraphs.en: Marilla listened as Anne continued, "And we had ice cream. Words fail to describe that ice cream. It was sublime."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉听着安妮继续说：“我们还吃了冰淇淋。言语无法形容那冰淇淋的美味。它真是美妙绝伦。”

paragraphs.en: That evening, Marilla recounted the entire incident to Matthew while working on her stocking.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，玛丽拉在织毛袜时把整个事情都告诉了马修。

paragraphs.en: "I admit my mistake," she said frankly, "but I've learned from it. I can't help laughing at Anne's 'confession,' though I shouldn't, as it was a lie. Yet, it seems less harmful than what could have been.
paragraphs.zh: “我承认自己的错误，”她坦率地说，“但我也从中吸取了教训。尽管我不该笑Anne的‘忏悔’——那其实是个谎言，我还是忍不住觉得它没那么有害。”

paragraphs.en: I'm responsible for it. Despite being hard to understand sometimes, I believe Anne will turn out well. And one thing is certain: no house would be dull with her around."
paragraphs.zh: 我得为这事负责。尽管她有时让人费解，但我相信她最终会成为一个不错的人。而且可以肯定的是，有她在的地方绝不会单调乏味。
